nodes.title: Migrate to CUCO-reaper monorepo (Lua + JSFX, dev-folder + symlinks)
nodes.description:
Migrate from REAPER's runtime folders into a single dev-folder git repo at `~/Work/Development/CUCO-reaper/`, then symlink REAPER's paths back so REAPER reads through the dev source.

Source today:
- `~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/Scripts/CUCO/` (already a git repo with this IG)
- `~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/Effects/CUCO_plugins/` (no git, just files)

Target:
```
~/Work/Development/CUCO-reaper/
├── .git/  CLAUDE.md  .planning/  .claude/  .issues.json  tools/
├── Scripts/CUCO/   (existing project content; symlink → REAPER/Scripts/CUCO)
├── Effects/        (JSFX moved here; symlink → REAPER/Effects/CUCO)
│   ├── lib/  Mixing/  Modulation/
└── Instruments/    (empty, future; symlink → REAPER/Effects/CUCO Instruments later)
```

Sequence:
1. Pre-flight commit any pre-existing uncommitted Lua-side mods so the move is a clean tree-shape change.
2. `mv "$REAPER_HOME/Scripts/CUCO" "$DEV/CUCO-reaper"` — preserves `.git/`.
3. Inside repo: create `Scripts/CUCO/`, `git mv` existing project content into it, leaving meta files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.planning/`, `.claude/`, `.issues.json`, `tools/`) at root.
4. `mv "$REAPER_HOME/Effects/CUCO_plugins"/* Effects/`. Reorganize into `lib/`, `Mixing/` (CUCO ReCenter family), `Modulation/` (CUCO Sweep).
5. Update JSFX imports in 2 files (CUCO Sweep, CUCO ReCenter v5): `import CUCO_plugins/lib/...` → `import CUCO/lib/...`.
6. Move docs from `Effects/CUCO_plugins/docs/` → `.planning/research/`. Delete the placeholder at `Effects/CUCO_plugins/docs/handover.md` (was a redirect; its canonical content is the handover at `.planning/handovers/`).
7. Symlinks: `ln -sfn "$DEV/CUCO-reaper/Scripts/CUCO" "$REAPER_HOME/Scripts/CUCO"`; same for `Effects/CUCO`.
8. Sanity-load both JSFX plugins from new symlinked location to confirm imports resolve.
9. One commit: `chore: restructure as CUCO-reaper monorepo (Lua + JSFX)`.

Layout is ReaPack-ready (Scripts/, Effects/ at root match REAPER's runtime tree) but ReaPack metadata is out of scope for this task — separate follow-up.

Full session context (what was built, audio-test plan, DSP gotchas, suite conventions) lives in the handover doc + the JSFX research docs that move in step 6.

notes.text: Migration landed at 8d279f6. New tree: Scripts/CUCO/ + Effects/ + tools/ at ~/Work/Development/CUCO-reaper, symlinked to REAPER's runtime paths. scripts/ → tools/ rename was an unforeseen step (case collision with Scripts/ on case-insensitive APFS); 10 files updated. JSFX: 5 unbucketed plugins (Additive, Spear, Multiband Correlation Meter, ABLevelMatching_Modified, JM_ana_Correlation) at Effects/ root pending future categorisation. Sanity-load of the two new JSFX (CUCO Sweep, CUCO ReCenter v5) from new symlinked location is the user's verification step (REAPER reload required).

nodes.title: execute_code stores engine wrapper instead of plan — entire send-to-REAPER pipe dead
nodes.description: engine.process_notation returns `{ ok=true, plan=..., ctx=... }` (engine.lua:30) but execute_code in `Scripts/CUCO/projects/curlop/CUCO OP 2.lua:589-590` stores the wrapper into `state.execution.last_result` AND `state.execution.output_events`. The count `#result` at line 593 reports 0 for the wrapper, so 'Generated 0 events' fires even when the engine produced events. Downstream consumers iterate `output_events` expecting `event.s` / `event.pitch` / `event.e` (lines 658, 807, 836, 1453, and update_target_item at line 658) — those keys live on `result.plan[i]`, not on the wrapper. Net: nothing is ever written to MIDI even if the engine works perfectly. Fix is ~5 lines: assign `result.plan` and re-check the count + `last_error`.

nodes.title: Parser never emits NOTE node — note tokens like c4/d#4 become no-op IDENTs
nodes.description: `Scripts/CUCO/projects/curlop/src/engine/parser.lua:55-57` parses every IDENT token (including `c4`, `d#4`, `melody`) as `AST.IDENT` with no note-name interpretation. The executor's NOTE branch at executor.lua:41 is dead code — no NOTE node is ever produced. The CHORD branch (executor.lua:49) iterates `node.notes` whose children are IDENT atoms with no `pitch` field, so all events default to pitch 60. Result: every template in the inline block (CUCO OP 2.lua:60-516) and every script in the library produces either 0 events or stacked C5s. Fix needs (a) note-name regex on IDENT text (e.g. `^([a-g])([#b]?)(%-?%d+)$`), (b) MIDI-note table mapping, (c) parser emitting `AST.NOTE` with `pitch` when the IDENT matches.

nodes.title: De-duplicate CUCO OP 2 templates — inline block vs script library
nodes.description: CUCO OP 2.lua:60-516 hardcodes ~400 lines of `templates = {...}` AND `init_script_library` (line 519) calls `template_migration.migrate_templates(script_library)` to seed the same content into the script library. Two sources of truth. Keep the script library; delete the inline block. Verify migration still works on a fresh install (no existing library file).

nodes.title: Strip dead editor UI state from CUCO OP 2
nodes.description: `state.editor.syntax_tokens` and `state.editor.error_markers` (CUCO OP 2.lua:63-64) are declared but never populated or rendered. `state.editor.cursor_line` / `cursor_col` (lines 60-61) declared, never updated — the editor uses `ImGui_InputTextMultiline` (line 1335) which manages its own cursor. `state.template_categories = {}` (line 120) declared, never used. `state.execution.last_result` is set but only `output_events` is read downstream. Remove these unused fields to reduce maintenance noise. Re-add them when actually wiring syntax highlighting / error markers / cursor reporting.

nodes.title: Hide or remove placeholder Documentation panel in CUCO OP 2
nodes.description: render_documentation_panel (CUCO OP 2.lua:1255-1281) renders a Search input that does nothing (line 1264 — `search_text` is local, never read), 10 hardcoded function names (lines 1268-1271), and a `-- TODO: Show function documentation` at line 1275. The panel advertises a help system that isn't there. Either: (a) delete the panel + its toggle in render_menu_bar; or (b) populate from the chatgpt function list spec at `src/processors/chatgpt function list.lua` to make the panel real. Don't ship dead UI.

nodes.title: Coalesce per-keystroke undo pushes in CUCO OP 2
nodes.description: CUCO OP 2.lua:1339-1343 calls `undo_manager.push_state` on every editor change — every keystroke becomes its own undo step. `MAX_HISTORY_SIZE = 50` in undo_manager.lua means typing fills the stack with single-char diffs and silently drops older real states. Coalesce: debounce by N ms of inactivity, OR commit on word boundary (space/newline), OR commit on pause+blur. Either approach is fine; pick whichever feels best in a quick prototype.

nodes.title: CUCO OP v2 direction — revive engine, capture-and-archive, or status-quo+repairs
nodes.description:
Audit on 2026-05-08 found the spec↔implementation gap is ~90%: tokenizer + parser are real, executor is a stub (no timesig/grid/processors/RNG/MPE), the processors/ tree contains spec stubs (lfo.lua = 0 bytes; most files <100 bytes), and the integration layer has a result-shape bug (B-001) blocking the send-to-REAPER pipe even if the engine worked. Three options surfaced:

**A) Smallest unit of 'it does anything at all'** (~1-2 days) — fix B-001 (5 lines), implement note-name parsing for B-002 (~30 lines), wire `[ ]` to advance time per element, fix CHORD parse path for `( )`. Outcome: typing `[c4 d4 e4 f4]` writes 4 sequential notes. The IDE comes alive on a tiny subset of the language.

**B) Capture-and-archive** (~2 hours) — move the language doc + processor function list into `.planning/specs/` proper, archive the codebase as `archive/cuco-op-v2/`, pick up later or rebuild on a different foundation.

**C) Status-quo + scoped repairs** — only fix B-001, dedup templates (T-022), strip dead UI (T-023), hide placeholder docs (T-024). Don't expand the language. Treat as a notation playground.

No decision yet. Promotes to subfeature/task on commit, or to knowledge if route B is taken.

nodes.title: Tidal Notation v1.0 grammar specification
nodes.description:
Canonical contract for the v1.0 grammar. Hard break from v0.8.1 — no back-compat for the v0.8.1 corpus; T-028 regression corpus is rewritten in v1.0 syntax.

Paradigm boundary: notes-only. Tidal Notation generates MIDI item content at parse time — it is NOT a real-time modulator host. CURLOP control-ops (lfo, ad, adsr, random as modulator, keytrack, glide-as-continuous, accum, bernoulli, shepard) and MIDI CC syntax are out of scope for v1.0. Only constructs that resolve to fixed events at generation time are valid.

Source surface: take name (short form). P_NOTES long-form is Phase 4 (additive, doesn't block v1.0).

Core grammar:
- `/` step delimiter (events between two `/` share a step; required, no whitespace fallback)
- `,` within-step delimiter (separates parallel events AND blocks op attachment to preceding note)
- whitespace adjacency between note and op = op attaches to preceding note; comma between them = no attachment (orphan op silently dropped)
- `-` rest, `_` hold (sustains all notes from previous step)
- `[]` = multi-step OP-scope grouping (e.g. `[c3 / g4] reverse` reverses contained step sequence)
- `()` = sub-step subdivision (carry-forward from v0.8.1)
- chord names: `c4.maj7` token, expanded at parse time to comma-separated parallel notes on same step
- negative octaves: `c-1` = MIDI 0 (already supported by v0.8.1 tokenizer)
- velocity values 0-127 everywhere (MIDI native); time/duration values musical only (1/16, 1/4 etc., no ms)

Per-step OPs (whitespace-attached, comma-blocked):
- `step:N` step size (musical)
- `repeat:N` step repeat count
- `reverse` reverses note order in scope; on single-step parallel notes = no-op
- `timescale:N` stretches step duration
- `octave:±N` transpose by octaves
- `grid:1/N` quantize event onsets (musical only)
- `scale(root, type)` quantize emissions to scale (e.g. `scale(c, major)`)
- `groove(type, amount)` swing/groove post-process
- `arp(type, scaler)` type ∈ {up, down, updown, random}; scaler = unit-around-1 (relative to local step) OR absolute musical; subdivides per-step inside `[]`
- `ratchet(count)` accepts decimals; interval = scope/count; hits placed at every interval start within scope
- `strum(time, direction)` staggers parallel/chord notes
- `humanize(vel, time)` vel 0-127 max delta, time 0-1 percentage of step (sole jitter primitive — replaces deviate)

Per-event attributes (whitespace-attached):
- `vel:N` velocity 0-127
- `len:N` absolute note duration (musical)
- `ch:N` MIDI channel 1-16

Articulations (CURLOP-aligned signatures, time args musical):
- `flam(time, amp)` defaults 1/64, 0.5
- `bounce(gravity)` 0-1, default 0.5 (higher = quicker decay)
- `buzz(pressure)` 0-1, default 0.5 (duration baked)
- `geiger(density)` 0-1, default 0.5 (Poisson retrigger rate)
- `glide(time)` musical, default 1/16 (pitch glide to next note)

Headers (runtime flags only — music ops live in scope):
- `//force` bypass parse cache (B-004)
- `//debug` existing v0.8.1 idiom

OP-interaction model — left-to-right waterfall within a header:
- chord → arp = arpeggiated chord
- grid → timescale = quantize then stretch
- arp → reverse = reversed arpeggio
- chord → reverse = no-op (parallel notes have no order)
- humanize → grid = anti-pattern (humanize defeats grid); document, don't error

Removed from v1.0 scope: `[]` polyphony semantics (commas handle this now), `~` as rest, `+N` offset prefix, MIDI CC syntax, real-time control-ops, `gate` (use `len`), `deviate` (folded into `humanize`), `@scale` and `!groove` directive forms (now scope-respecting OPs).

Diagnostics commitments (B-005 visual error feedback) and force-rerender (B-004) are addressed via header flags + parse-error surface.

Spec doc: `.planning/specs/tidal-notation-v1-grammar.md` (drafted as SPEC-004's companion, every forward-claim cites CURLOP `ScriptParser.cpp` / `ScriptCompiler.cpp` / `ScriptLanguage.cpp`, VST `syntax.js` / `music-math.js` / `groove.js`, or v0.8.1.lua line numbers).

notes.text: Spec drafted at .planning/specs/tidal-notation-v1-grammar.md, committed a8e762d. 13 sections, hard-break with v0.8.1, all supplementary rules locked. Ready for T-026 (Phase 0a).

nodes.title: Phase 0 — refactor executor to event-list intermediate (foundation for all subsequent phases)
nodes.description:
Currently make_executor (CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua:289-548) writes MIDI directly via insert_notes inside start_voice/flush_voice. Pivot to: executor pushes to an events[] array; a final write_events_to_midi pass at the end inserts them all. Pure refactor — same audible output, but with an event-list intermediate that all post-processors (groove, scale, articulations) can transform.

This is the unblocking step for Phase 1-3.

nodes.title: Phase 1 — chord names, scale context, groove post-processor (cheap wins on event-list architecture)
nodes.description:
Add the high-value features that don't require grammar changes, riding the event-list refactor from Phase 0:
- Chord names (`c4.maj7`, `d.min`, `g.dom7`) via CHORDS table from VST music-math.js
- Scale context: `@scale c.major` header directive + quantizeToScale post-processor
- Groove (8 swing/shuffle/push/quint/sept/samba/elastic/fractal modes) as event-list post-processor
- Per-event vel: and ch: attributes

nodes.title: Phase 2 — `/` step delimiter + step:/len: attributes (grammar pivot)
nodes.description:
Real grammar work. Tokenizer learns `/` as STEP_BOUNDARY. Parser switches to accumulator model: Step container holds an events[] list; `/` boundary pushes the accumulated step. step:N at step level multiplies that step's duration (CURLOP getStepMultiplierFor model). len:N at event level sets gate length independent of step advancement.

Backward compat: bare whitespace-separated tokens (no `/`) parse as 1-event-per-step; existing v0.8.1 scripts continue to work.

nodes.title: Phase 3 — articulations (flam, bounce, buzz, gate, glide, geiger)
nodes.description:
Each articulation is an event-list post-processor that takes 1 event in and produces N events out. Drop-in once Phase 0 is done.
- flam:1/32 — grace note before main
- bounce:0.5 — decaying repeats filling the step
- buzz — trill
- gate:0.5 — shorten release (one-event mutator)
- glide — portamento bend
- geiger — random clusters

VST sources at /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/attributes/{flam,bounce,buzz,gate,glide,geiger}.js. Most are <100 lines each.

nodes.title: Phase 4 — hybrid source surface (take name OR P_NOTES)
nodes.description: Take names cap around 70 displayed chars. Once articulations and multi-channel arrive, scripts won't fit. Hybrid: if take name is `~note` or empty, read source from P_NOTES instead of P_NAME. Watcher needs to detect P_NOTES change (not just P_NAME). Origin-tracking still works (CTN tag survives in P_NOTES alongside source — disambiguate by line prefix).

nodes.title: Phase 0a — refactor make_executor to push to events[] instead of inserting MIDI
nodes.description: make_executor (CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua:289-548) currently calls insert_notes inside the write branch of flush_voice/flush_all. Replace direct MIDI inserts with `events[#events+1] = { pitch, sQN, eQN, vel, ch, attrs }`. Same data, deferred write.

notes.text: Refactor committed in 09b5835 — events[] closure-owned, terminal write pass via write_events_to_midi. UNVERIFIED in REAPER; byte-identical hash check is the gating step before close. See handover doc.

nodes.title: Phase 0b — add write_events_to_midi terminal pass
nodes.description: After all tokens are processed and post-processors run, iterate the events[] array and call MIDI_InsertNote per event, then MIDI_Sort. Mirrors the current write loop but operates on a finished list.

nodes.title: Phase 0c — verify plan/scan diff harness still passes on v0.8.1 corpus
nodes.description: Capture 10-15 representative names from current v0.8.1 templates as a corpus. Run with //debug //full and confirm `[CHECK] mismatches=0` after the refactor. Build a tiny test runner that re-renders each name and grep for the mismatch count. This becomes the regression net for Phases 1-3.

nodes.title: Phase 1a — port CHORDS table + chord-name expansion (c4.maj7, d.min, g.dom7)
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/core/utils/music-math.js:39-105. Translate CHORDS table to Lua. Extend the executor's note-handler to detect `.qualifier` after a note (regex `^([a-gA-G][b#]?-?%d+)%.([%w]+)$`), look up the qualifier in CHORDS, expand into a baked stack of pitches at that step.

nodes.title: Phase 1b — port SCALES table + quantizeToScale + @scale header directive
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/core/utils/music-math.js:5-37 (SCALES) + 125-178 (quantizeToScale). Plus /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/processors/scale.js. Add `@scale c.major` parse to parse_step_header (CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua:112-129). Run as post-processor on events[] before write.

nodes.title: Phase 1c — port groove.js (8 swing modes) as event-list post-processor
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/processors/groove.js (101 lines). Port verbatim to Lua. Modes: swing, shuffle, push, quint, sept, samba, elastic, fractal. Each adjusts event time + velocity. Wire as `//groove(swing,50,20)` flag in name (consistent with existing //debug flag pattern), or as `!groove(...)` if processor syntax is added.

nodes.title: Phase 1d — per-event vel:N and ch:N attribute attachments
nodes.description: Add `:` attribute parsing in the tokenizer for the simple case `<note>:vel:N` or `<note>:ch:N`. Apply by attaching to the event before write. Parses cheap; integrates with the event-list architecture from Phase 0.

nodes.title: Phase 2a — tokenizer learns `/` as STEP_BOUNDARY
nodes.description: Add `/` as a token in tokenize() (CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua:226). Distinct from FRACTION (`N/M` numeric). Parser uses STEP_BOUNDARY to flush the accumulating step.

nodes.title: Phase 2b — parser switches to accumulator model (Step container with events[])
nodes.description: Mirror CURLOP ScriptParser.cpp:1660-1694 (parseSeqBody) accumulator. Tokens accumulate into a Step's events[]; `/` pushes the step and resets. Whitespace alone NO LONGER advances; only `/` (or end-of-input) does. Back-compat: when no `/` is present, treat each whitespace-separated token as if followed by an implicit `/` (current v0.8.1 semantics preserved for legacy names).

nodes.title: Phase 2c — implement step:N step-level processor (multiplies step duration)
nodes.description: Mirror CURLOP getStepMultiplierFor (ScriptParser.cpp:2002-2028). step:2 = 2× step duration; step:0.5 = half. Supports number or fraction (1/16). Apply as a multiplier when computing per-step QN window in the executor.

nodes.title: Phase 2d — implement len:N per-event attribute (gate length independent of step)
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/attributes/length.js. Per-event attribute that sets the event's eQN to sQN + len*stepQN, decoupling note duration from the step's cursor advancement. Allows `c4 len:2 / d4` (c4 sustains 2 steps; cursor advances 1 step before d4).

nodes.title: Phase 3a — port flam (grace + main)
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/attributes/flam.js (30 lines). `flam:1/32` adds a grace note offset before the main note. Event-list post-processor: 1 event in → 2 events out.

nodes.title: Phase 3b — port bounce (decaying repeats filling step)
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/attributes/bounce.js (88 lines). `bounce:0.5` simulates a bouncing-ball decay; gravity arg controls density. 1 event in → N events out filling the step duration.

nodes.title: Phase 3c — port buzz (trill)
nodes.description: Source: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/attributes/buzz.js (71 lines). `buzz:N` rapidly alternates between the note and N semitones above. 1 event in → many events out at sub-step rate.

nodes.title: Phase 3d — port gate, glide, geiger
nodes.description: Sources: /Users/f.god/Work/Development/CUCO-OP-VST/src/attributes/{gate,glide,geiger}.js. gate:0.5 = release shortener (1-in-1-out mutator); glide = portamento bend lane; geiger = random sub-step clusters.

nodes.title: Phase 4a — hybrid source: read from P_NOTES when take name is `~note` or empty
nodes.description: When take name starts with `~note` (or is empty after `~`-prefix detection), pull the actual notation from item P_NOTES. Disambiguate from CTN tag by line prefix: CTN line stays as `CTN:xxxxxxxx`; source lines are everything else.

nodes.title: Phase 4b — watcher detects P_NOTES change (not just P_NAME)
nodes.description: scan_once (line 856) currently only watches P_NAME. Add P_NOTES hashing/comparison for items whose name signals hybrid mode. Handle the increased poll cost (notes can be long; hash for cheap diff).

nodes.title: No ReaPack header on Tidal Notation script — not installable via ReaPack
nodes.description: CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua:1-20 uses a custom `[[ReaScript Name: ...]]` block. Missing standard ReaPack tags: @version, @author, @description, @about, @license, @changelog. ~10 lines to retrofit. Distribution-relevant for any future M-NEW that publishes Tidal Notation.

nodes.title: Tidal Notation committed-name dedup has no force-rerender escape hatch
nodes.description: Line 830 of CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua: `if committed and committed == name then return`. Once a name is committed, you can never re-trigger that exact name (e.g. after tempo change or manual MIDI edits). Only escape: rename to something else, then back. Add `//force` flag (parsed in parse_flags) that bypasses the committed-name check.

nodes.title: Tidal Notation has no visual error feedback — silent failure if console is closed
nodes.description: Parse/runtime errors go through pcall to logln (CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua:832). If the REAPER console is closed, the user sees a take with stale MIDI and no indication that the latest name failed. For a live-coding tool this gap is significant. Suggest: prefix `❌ ` to take name, or set item color red on parse failure.

nodes.title: Tidal Notation stack `[]` cannot contain groups `()` — asymmetric grammar
nodes.description: Line 459 of CUCO Tidal Notation 0.8.1.lua explicitly bails on non-string entries inside a stack: `(group-inside-stack is parked — ignore non-strings here)`. Stack parser (lines 234-237) splits inner by whitespace into flat strings only. Means `[c4 (e4 g4 b4) _]` (per-voice column where voice 2 plays a 3-note subdivision) is invalid. Should be a recursive parse, symmetric with how groups already accept nested tokens via `tokenize(inner)` (line 246).

nodes.title: Verify ReaPack import in fresh REAPER (T-021 steps 6-7)
Control-driven JSFX architecture (recursive framers → sequencers → processors)
nodes.description: A subset of the CUCO JSFX suite (opt-in, not house style) follows a recursive control-driven architecture. Three layers — framers (Keyframer, Random Walk, REAPER envelopes, Tidal) generate control data into sliders; sequencers (control-driven JSFX MIDI/CC sources) take slider values → emit MIDI; processors (control-driven JSFX audio effects/generators) take slider values + audio in → emit audio out. The same invariants repeat at every layer: simple, focused, mono-purpose, slider-saturated, automation-receptive. Only the I/O domain changes. JSFX is the right format because every slider is a uniform automation surface, sequencers and processors live on the same FX chain on the same track, and the hidden-slider trick (`-` prefix) gives a clean GUI-only window without sacrificing automation. This is a tagged design pattern — utility/mixing/metering JSFX (ReCenter, Multiband Correlation Meter) are exempt and have their own contracts. See .planning/research/control-driven-jsfx-architecture.md for the full philosophy and SPEC-005/SPEC-006 for the domain contracts.

nodes.title: control-driven-jsfx-processors
nodes.description: v0.1 draft. Defines the contract a CUCO JSFX must satisfy to be classified as a control-driven processor: an audio-in/audio-out (or audio-out generator) unit whose entire musical surface is a slider-saturated, automation-receptive transfer function. Opt-in criteria: audio I/O, mono-purpose, slider-complete, gestural. Required conventions cover sliders (hidden `-` prefix, bipolar where natural, <32 sliders), DSP discipline (allocate in @init, smooth in @sample, no per-sample FFTs), GUI (build on geraintluff/jsfx-ui-lib + cuco_theme + cuco_widgets, ui_automate for all slider writes), and persistence (@serialize for non-slider state, 32-bit float caveat). Currently-conforming candidates: CUCO Sweep (needs audit). Currently-exempt: ReCenter, Multiband Correlation Meter, JM_ana_Correlation, ABLevelMatching_Modified, CUCO Additive. See .planning/specs/control-driven-jsfx-processors.md.

nodes.title: control-driven-jsfx-sequencers
nodes.description: v0.1 draft. Defines the contract a CUCO JSFX must satisfy to be classified as a control-driven sequencer: a MIDI/CC source whose entire sequence shape (steps, density, swing, scale, range, gate) is encoded as sliders that are themselves automation-receptive — so framers (Keyframer, Random Walk, envelope lanes) can modulate the sequence in real time. Sequencers are peers to Keyframer/Random Walk in the framer hierarchy but live in the FX chain rather than ReaScript. Opt-in criteria: MIDI/CC out via midisend, sequence shape is sliders, framer-receptive (modulation while playing without glitch), transport-synced via play_position/beat_position. Required conventions cover MIDI emission (sample-accurate offset, declared MIDI stance — replace/passthrough/merge/filter, note-off discipline, no stuck notes), sliders (hidden `-` prefix, bipolar where natural, slider-budget strategies — generative vs compact-step-storage vs per-step-automation-lane), step storage exception (bulk step data may live in @serialize if non-modulatable + integer-quantized), transport sync (drive from beat_position not sample counters, loop-aware), GUI (must visualize current sequence state). Currently in suite: none — no JSFX sequencer exists yet, this SPEC defines the contract for future work. See .planning/specs/control-driven-jsfx-sequencers.md.
